method.construction: shared random-walk common factor + OU mean-reverting spread (phi=0.85, sigma=0.02) + idiosyncratic noise

notes: Synthetic data is by-construction cointegrated, so 92% WR / 25 Sharpe is a SANITY CHECK that the math works, NOT a forecast of live performance.
